summary: Executed backend pytest suite and mobile-first Expo web checks for call/chat routes. Backend APIs passed; one critical frontend integration regression reproduced on chat route.

ui_bugs.issue: Route shows React red error overlay instead of graceful unavailable fallback when unauthenticated; Convex query throws server error at ChatScreen useQuery(api.conversations.getConversation).

integration_issues.flow: Open /chat/testconversation1 in web/mobile preview while signed out
integration_issues.issue: Uncaught Convex server error is surfaced to user (Called by client) instead of guarded skip/fallback flow.

Code path may still mark failed translations as completed because translateIncomingMessageText returns original text on failure, and caller marks any truthy result as translated (no explicit success/failure signal).

action_items: Gate chat conversation/messages/current-user queries behind auth (similar to call screen canRunCallQueries) to prevent signed-out Convex throws.
Add defensive error boundary/handled query-error state for chat route so users see fallback UI, not red overlay.
Revisit translation completion tracking to distinguish successful translation vs fallback/original-text return so failed requests can retry as intended.
Retest live device-only scenarios after fix: incoming call receiver name, ringing stop on caller hangup during ringing, live presence updates, and authenticated real-time translation display.
critical_code_review_comments: app/chat/[conversationId].tsx and app/call/[conversationId].tsx are very large (>700 lines), increasing regression risk and reducing maintainability.
translation.ts uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while project guidance emphasizes EXPO_BACKEND_URL/Constants extra key usage; env-key consistency should be verified across build targets.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ status row via backend test: test_status_create_and_persisted_get
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth-dependent/live Convex checks remain partially blocked in browser automation due third-party OIDC and need real signed-in device/account. Call route displayName query param rendered correctly ('Asare Ben Chris').
rca_of_issue: RCA for reproduced crash: chat route directly executes useQuery(api.conversations.getConversation, {conversationId}) when conversationId is syntactically valid, without authentication guard. In signed-out state this throws Convex server error and triggers red overlay. Reproduction: open /chat/testconversation1 on preview while signed out -> Uncaught Error [CONVEX Q(conversations:getConversation)] Called by client.
